description: IMFINZI in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is indicated for the first-line treatment of adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer who are candidates for systemic therapy, followed by maintenance treatment with IMFINZI as monotherapy in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) or IMFINZI in combination with olaparib in endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair proficient (pMMR).
